title: District immunisation coverage in 2023
question: What is the 2023 district immunisation table, and which district had the lowest coverage?

view.title: District immunisation coverage in 2023
view.note: Each bar shows the percentage of children fully immunised out of those due in that district for 2023. The shortest bar is the district with the lowest coverage. A downloadable table of the same 2023 figures is available below the chart.

insight_specs.message: The data shows which district had the lowest coverage in 2023 but cannot explain why that district's coverage was lower than the others.

insights.label: What this data cannot answer
insights.text: This file shows differences and changes, but it has no explanatory variables and cannot establish why they occurred.

source.provenance: Deterministic synthetic smoke data created for harness verification; no people or sensitive records.
